review.intro: Overnight: six h_z sweeps at fixed (h_x, h_y) across the wall corner, all complete, 0 failures. Five level crossings, each within 0.06 of the mean-field prediction (MF - 0.06); the wall weakens outward (B_p jump 0.48 -> 0.12). The Bridge tab has the full predicted-vs-measured table and per-cut panels; each item below opens the cut (filled = up, hollow = dn).

items.text: Clean first order: up jumps 0.45->0.5, dn drops 0.3->0.25 (loop 0.3-0.45), level switch 0.35->0.4, B_p jump 0.34. This fills the gap between the x-flank end (0.725, 1.0) and the y-flank start (0.5, 1.4): at h_z = 0.4 the wall is one smooth closed ring.

items.text: Added overnight (pred 0.797). The up anchor diverged at step 170 (genuine) -> parked, relaunched with the gentle anchor recipe (59017917, pending); dn (59004847) running. Tests the extrapolated corner rim ~(1.24, 1.2, 0.80).

bridge.intro: Wall-corner 'bridge' cuts: h_z sweeps at fixed (h_x, h_y) across the one Higgs|confined wall, between the x|z tails (h_x sweeps, h_y <= 1.0) and the z|y lines (h_z sweeps, h_x <= 0.5). Up train: cold anchor at h_z = 0.05 (confined, x/y-canted) then warm links upward; dn train: cold anchor at window top + 0.1 (z-pol, Higgs) then warm links downward. Predicted = product-state mean field (L=4 OBC weights) - 0.06 (NQS - MF = -0.066 +- 0.03 over 28 located wall points). Measured = the viewer's locator at L=4 (first-order electric cut: level crossing, else M_z jump). Wall strength = max |<B_p>_up - <B_p>_dn| over the up/dn overlap.
